bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 71
if git -C "$r/.worktrees/userbot-room-public-cb3e13c" show cb3e13c2156f5f8b04645adb121057e88d1c2b4a:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"; then
  test -f "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" || exit 72

elif git -C "$r/.worktrees/userbot-room-public-cb3e13c" show fb5aaa24e85f304261dd927e02bbcccc66bc4dfa:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"; then
  echo USERBOT_PUBLIC_WORKER_SOURCE=BASE
else
  echo USERBOT_PUBLIC_WORKER_SOURCE=UNKNOWN
  exit 73
fi
PYTHONPATH="$r/scripts" "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from userbot_test_client import invoke
result = asyncio.run(invoke('health'))
if result.get('status') != 'PASS' or result.get('authorized') is not True:
    raise SystemExit(74)

echo USERBOT_WORKER_SOURCE_PREFLIGHT=PASS
